free_tier.stated: Free account exists ('Sign Up'). What premium removes is the queue, not a quota: 'No Waiting | No Ads | No Captcha | Fast Download'. The account bar renders 'Traffic available today: Unlimited' with an empty balance and an empty used-space field, which is unpopulated template text and not a statement of the free allowance.
free_tier.notes: The free tier's real download allowance was not published on the page read.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the page read

retention.stated: not stated on the page read

egress.terms: Premium is sold as speed and queue removal only; no byte allowance is printed for either tier. The account bar's 'Traffic available today' field is a template with no value behind it, so neither tier's transfer cap is established.

record.interface_detail: Web upload and link checker. No API or FTP on the page read.
record.tooling: Browser only as read; the site is on the Leechall generator list. Clicknupload also runs an affiliate programme ('Make Money'), so many links in the wild are placed to earn rather than shared.
record.chaining: The cheapest paid month of the file hosts swept at $15, with a $50 year. Because free traffic is already unlimited per day, the $15 buys time rather than bytes - which is the only case in tested services where a host's paid tier is worth it for a small pull.

limits.value: free downloads carry a wait and a captcha per file; premium removes both
unstated: the account bar's traffic field renders as empty template text

record.limits_note: Neither the free nor the paid transfer ceiling is published. The only quantified thing on the page is the price.
record.binding_note: With no published byte ceiling, the wait and captcha on the free tier is the only constraint that can be named from the evidence. $15 removes it; what remains unknown is whether a byte cap appears behind it.

identity_cost.detail: Payment options on the premium page: Visa/MasterCard, Way2Bill, PayPal, Bitcoin, Litecoin, USDT (TRC20), ETH. A premium key can also be bought from resellers for the same four prices.

record.reliability_note: The site states 'Different fees are applied by payment providers', so the listed $15 is not what a card is charged; the reseller key route avoids the processor fee and adds a reseller's margin.
record.confidence_note: Prices and payment methods read on the vendor premium page. The free tier's allowance, speed and per-file cap are all unpublished, so the 'unlimited' text in the account bar is recorded as template, not evidence.

evidence.proved: the four prices ($15 30 days, $25 90 days, $40 180 days, $50 365 days), the identical reseller key prices, 'No Waiting | No Ads | No Captcha | Fast Download', and the payment list including USDT TRC20, Litecoin and ETH
the site now serves from clicknupload.click; .org redirects to the .click login page, which is why the record cites .click

record.price_per_tb_month: USD 15 per 30 days, no volume figure published
record.notes: The $50 annual plan equals $4.17 per month. Cryptocurrency payment without cards is supported. Account dashboard displays 'Traffic available today: Unlimited'.

extras.payments: Visa/MasterCard, Way2Bill, PayPal, Bitcoin, Litecoin, USDT TRC20, ETH
extras.resellers: same four prices as premium keys
